tables.name: device_lifecycle_heads
databaseConstraints: PK device_id; FK devices(id), authority_gate_key -> approval_authorization_gates(gate_key)
epoch is exact unsigned integer encoding, no floating point; concrete storage bound awaits device profile
transactionRules: Head is current lineage pointer, not independent authorization authority. All writers lock shared rank-0 gate before head; missing head denies; revision monotonic, no epoch inference from firmware version.

tables.name: device_fence_reasons
databaseConstraints: PK device_id,reason_kind,reason_id; released history retained
transactionRules: Release only exact reason owned by operation; effective shared gate stays held while any blocking reason remains. Purpose-specific recovery commands may operate under held gate; never make global gate open for cleanup. Existing revoke/scope conditions still apply.

tables.name: lifecycle_reset_jobs
databaseConstraints: PK job_id; UNIQUE commit_id WHERE nonnull; UNIQUE completion_handle WHERE nonnull
Composite references require matching device/rental/binding lineage, not independent valid IDs
transactionRules: grant_issued never true->false; no terminal downgrade; one nonterminal reset lineage per current device enforced under head lock + unique active slot. Issuance reservation is conservative grant-issued barrier even before signing finishes; cancel forbidden thereafter.

tables.name: lifecycle_permits
databaseConstraints: PK permit_id; UNIQUE owner_kind,owner_id,purpose
Explicit owner-kind discriminator; service validates typed owner FK when physical mapping selected
transactionRules: Immutable canonical payload authorized before signer starts; payload object reference + issuance reservation committed. Signature worker cannot change context; first durable signed object fixes digest; later alternate bytes quarantined, never overwrite. No response/outbox emits permit bytes before signed link commit; missing bytes never rolls back grant barrier.

tables.name: lifecycle_evidence
databaseConstraints: PK evidence_id; UNIQUE owner_kind,owner_id,kind,ciphertext_digest
transactionRules: Digest dedup is not authority. Validate full parent context, expected purpose, signer and protected envelope. Challenge-specific cleanup proofs can differ for same result; append evidence, apply semantic business effect once. Recheck current gates after external verification; verified flag alone grants nothing.

tables.name: lifecycle_objects
databaseConstraints: PK object_id; UNIQUE store_ref; immutable object version/digest/length once linked
transactionRules: Separate namespace from approval_protected_objects whose kind enum excludes lifecycle payloads. Reuse protected-store adapter only, not false FK to existing unsupported kinds. Stage encrypted bytes before SQL link; no public URL or wallet secrets. GC must serialize reference creation/deletion via shared object registry and durable upload lease, not just age scan.

tables.name: lifecycle_reuse_gates
databaseConstraints: PK device_id,epoch; UNIQUE return_job_id; consumed state requires consumed_admission_id
transactionRules: Derived entitlement under same authority device gate, not a shadow authorization lock. Only valid current cleanup opens eligible; admission consumes once; historical eligible never current permission. Cancelled returns create no reuse gate.

tables.name: lifecycle_genesis_records
databaseConstraints: PK genesis_id; UNIQUE device_id
transactionRules: Only trusted provisioning verification creates record. Never reconstruct from missing rentals/reset records; retain consumed history through restore; no user supplied self-asserted virgin state.

tables.name: lifecycle_admissions
databaseConstraints: PK admission_id; UNIQUE rental_id; UNIQUE binding_id; UNIQUE basis_kind,basis_id
Device exclusivity through current head and rentals one_active_rental; historical active admissions remain history, not eternal partial unique device constraint
transactionRules: Admission reservation consumes basis and creates assigned rental plus reserved binding atomically; no timeout release. Positive matching device evidence advances state; no automatic second admission on lost activation.

tables.name: lifecycle_binding_states
databaseConstraints: PK binding_id; FK device_bindings(id); composite lineage verified with matching keys
Binding state active is necessary, never sufficient, for wallet signing
transactionRules: Proposed device_bindings wallet_origin nullable until actual wallet setup; NULL means unconfigured, never inferred new_travel/imported. Existing unique owner index reserves ownership even while unusable. All old signing readers must join this state and actual wallet authority; selecting revoked_at IS NULL alone is unsafe.

tables.name: lifecycle_cancellations
databaseConstraints: PK cancel_id; UNIQUE job_id across every state; commit_block true
No delete-and-reinsert to replace cancelled job lineage
transactionRules: Create only never-issued grant under shared locks. Keep server fence held until exact release evidence committed. Retain tombstone after completion; new return needs new job.

tables.name: lifecycle_relay_authorities
databaseConstraints: PK authority_id; actions nonempty; signed object linked
active requires signed_object_id; pending authority cannot authorize relay
transactionRules: Exact historical relationship or scoped operator plus primary auth required on issuance; restricted relay does not unlock owner signing. Renewal appends new authority with current proof, never edits original evidence AAD.

tables.name: lifecycle_challenges
databaseConstraints: PK challenge_id; consumed requires outcome_id
transactionRules: Challenge consumption and authoritative business result commit together. Verification pending consumes challenge only with durable pending outcome; later apply uses reserved submission lineage and rechecks gates. Fresh retry challenge may map same business outcome without repeating effects.

tables.name: lifecycle_outcomes
databaseConstraints: PK outcome_id; UNIQUE actor_namespace,action,entity_id,business_key
transactionRules: Durable lineage outlives ordinary response-cache TTL; current authorization before replay. Same key new payload conflicts; current-state projection separated from immutable original outcome. Does not store plaintext tokens/keys.

atomicUnits.title: 반납 점검·제한·준비 기록
atomicUnits.rule: Create/refresh exact job/check revisions, attach return reason and shared gate hold with audit/outcome/outbox; prepared requires actual device preparation evidence, not server fence alone. Recovery policy unresolved never qualifies destructive reset.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 초기화 허가 발급 결정
atomicUnits.rule: Under common lock, current checks+fresh prepare+physical approval and no cancellation; persist immutable execution payload and reserved permit; grant_issued=true monotonic, commit_issued phase. Sign only after this committed authorization; failed signing cannot make job cancellable.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 기존 초기화 증거·반납 완료
atomicUnits.rule: Verified exact reset evidence: rental returned/returned_at, revoke original device and wallet binding authority, update current epoch from validated profile transition, gate awaiting_cleanup, preserve fence and device head until cleanup, reserve completion ACK. Returned rental frees old partial unique rental index but lifecycle gate still forbids admission. This apply transaction records verification/application revision on the exact evidence row; raw reception is separately LST-T12.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 정리 확인
atomicUnits.rule: Verify current nextEpoch/ACK/cleanup and no new binding; mark own return cleanup complete, release own reason only. Eligible entitlement must not bypass other reasons or shared authority restrictions; projection reports current admission eligibility, not only reuse row state. This apply transaction records verification/application revision on the exact evidence row; raw reception is separately LST-T12.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 대여 예약
atomicUnits.rule: Current scoped operator/recipient consent/holder proof + all CAS; consume exactly one basis branch; insert rentals assigned, device_bindings reserved with unknown wallet_origin NULL; fix context; advance revisions and reserve admission permit. No TTL release.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 등록·활성화 증거
atomicUnits.rule: RL02 persists verified binding evidence and activation permit reservation; RL03 separately verifies activation receipt then marks rental/device/binding active. Both keep same exclusive rental and exact context; wallet remains unconfigured until separate setup. This apply transaction records verification/application revision on the exact evidence row; raw reception is separately LST-T12.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 단일 취소 intent
atomicUnits.rule: Lookup existing UNIQUE job lineage before creation. Never-issued exact current job only; persist permanent commit-block + cancel permit reservation; retain both fences. Different idempotency key cannot replace cancelId.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 취소 준비 무효화 확인
atomicUnits.rule: Verify exact durable device tombstone and never-issued grant, reserve release permit, mark release_issued; server fence remains held. This apply transaction records verification/application revision on the exact evidence row; raw reception is separately LST-T12.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 양측 취소 완료
atomicUnits.rule: Verify exact release receipt, job aborted + cancellation completed + release only matching reason; original rental/binding preserved, no epoch increment, no reuse gate. Restore only pre-return lifecycle availability allowed by other reasons. This apply transaction records verification/application revision on the exact evidence row; raw reception is separately LST-T12.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 중계 자격·challenge
atomicUnits.rule: Issue under current exact auth/action/holder/epoch with durable unique replay and outcomes; real signed bytes protected and no owner capability. Include existing approval_sender_replay adapter with explicit lifecycle namespace, pending schema adoption. Reserve immutable relay/cleanup signed payload before signing; pending relay authority grants no action. LST-T11 exclusively owns signed object linkage + authority activation; this unit only reserves pending issuance.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 서명 객체 연결과 중계 권한 활성화
atomicUnits.rule: Separate signer completion transaction verifies reserved payload/digest/profile before first signed object link. GETs do not sign or issue; current auth checks, safe projection, immutable permit recovery only. No protected bytes delivered before reference commit. For relay, current actor/authority revision, expiry, job/epoch and all scope predicates + signed object link + pending_signing to active commit together here. For all permits recheck applicable parent/current authority before linking/delivery; stale execution authorization remains grant-issued and held, never reset to cancellable. GET response handling itself is read-only except permitted auth replay metadata.
atomicUnits.completeCommitSet: candidateWrites + existingWrites + commonWrites; only applicable rows mutated, same enforceable transaction boundary

atomicUnits.title: 증거 접수와 검증 예약
atomicUnits.rule: Stage durable encrypted object first, validate current submission auth and identity, commit pending evidence/object link + consumed challenge when applicable + pending durable outcome. External verification follows; separate T03/T04/T06/T08/T09 rechecks current authoritative gates and applies verified result. Pending acceptance is not business completion. Retried fresh challenge maps original business outcome, never duplicate effects. Pending response schema extension is part of LST-D03.

firmwareStores.recovery: Same job only; missing or inconsistent history requires quarantine, never infer complete.

firmwareStores.name: Completion/cleanup marker
firmwareStores.recovery: Retain identity needed for fresh cleanup challenges; no marker means not clean.

firmwareStores.name: Admission state
records: activation permit digest and immutable receipts
firmwareStores.recovery: Power loss preserves exclusive lineage; device activation may precede server evidence. No another owner.

firmwareStores.name: Cancellation tombstone
firmwareStores.durableBefore: prepared proof; restriction release and release receipt as one recoverable durable transition
firmwareStores.recovery: Never reopen prepared grant acceptance. Reset/FOTA cannot discard protection metadata without selected migration profile.

migrations.procedure: Verified evidence-backed current heads; independent immutable history preserved; unknown devices/quarantined holds; CAS cursor checks concurrent revision.
migrations.exitGate: No default eligible, active, virgin or grant_issued=false for uncertain history.

migrations.procedure: Read-only projections compare lineage/rental/binding/gate; no shadow writer or signing.
migrations.exitGate: Mismatch blocks cutover; signed object retention recoverable.

migrations.procedure: Future crash/restore/power-loss/competing writer tests with chosen profiles and firmware; validate restore authority generation.
migrations.exitGate: Runtime cases remain not_run until evidence attached.

migrations.procedure: Switch compatible writers under gates; enforce durable unique constraints/typed FKs and deny old bypass DTOs.

migrations.procedure: Hold writes first; never rollback monotonic consumed/grant/cancel history. Restore trusted latest watermark and compare device evidence before unhold.
migrations.exitGate: Old backup is not authority; without external durable latest watermark stay quarantined.

storagePrinciples: Shared gate is authorization source; lifecycle summaries and reuse entitlement never independent shadow locks.
One enforceable SQL transaction domain for gate/lineage/rental/binding/outcome/outbox; split services require separate reservation protocol before adoption.
No hardware secret, seed, full MPC key, plaintext recording or user token in general SQL/audit/outbox.
Evidence verification/signing/blob IO outside DB transaction; current authoritative predicates rechecked at apply.
No grant/tombstone/consumed-basis rollback on TTL, response loss or backup restore.
Reference engine inherited PostgreSQL15 proposal only; concrete engine, integer bounds, key/retention/profile remain unselected.
